mapper.sql: id, job_uid, card_uid, base_revision_uid, template_key, template_version, theme_uid, theme_version, status, attempt_count, request_json, result_revision_uid, error_code, error_message, generation_outcome, warning, available_at, started_at, lease_token, lease_expires_at, finished_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM vocabulary_generation_job WHERE status = 'pending' AND available_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND attempt_count < 3 ORDER BY available_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM vocabulary_generation_job WHERE card_uid = #{cardUid} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE vocabulary_generation_job SET status = 'running', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, started_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, lease_token = #{leaseToken}, lease_expires_at = TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{leaseSeconds}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), finished_at = NULL, error_code = NULL, error_message = NULL, generation_outcome = NULL, warning = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE job_uid = #{jobUid} AND status = 'pending' AND available_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND attempt_count < 3

UPDATE vocabulary_generation_job SET status = 'succeeded', result_revision_uid = #{revisionUid}, generation_outcome = #{generationOutcome}, warning = #{warning}, finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, error_code = NULL, error_message = NULL, lease_token = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE job_uid = #{jobUid} AND status = 'running' AND lease_token = #{leaseToken} AND lease_expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

UPDATE vocabulary_generation_job SET status = 'failed' 'pending' , error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, generation_outcome = 'failed' NULL , warning = 'generation_failed' NULL , available_at = #{availableAt}, finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NULL , lease_token = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE job_uid = #{jobUid} AND status = 'running' AND lease_token = #{leaseToken} AND lease_expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

UPDATE vocabulary_generation_job SET status = 'cancelled', finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, lease_token = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE job_uid = #{jobUid} AND status = 'running' AND lease_token = #{leaseToken} AND lease_expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
UPDATE vocabulary_generation_job SET status = 'cancelled', finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE card_uid = #{cardUid} AND status = 'pending'

UPDATE vocabulary_generation_job SET status = 'cancelled', finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, lease_token = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE card_uid = #{cardUid} AND status IN ('pending', 'running')

UPDATE vocabulary_generation_job target LEFT JOIN vocabulary_generation_job newer ON newer.card_uid = target.card_uid AND newer.id > target.id SET target.status = 'pending', target.attempt_count = 0, target.available_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, target.started_at = NULL, target.finished_at = NULL, target.error_code = NULL, target.error_message = NULL, target.generation_outcome = NULL, target.warning = NULL, target.lease_token = NULL, target.lease_expires_at = NULL, target.updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE target.card_uid = #{cardUid} AND target.job_uid = #{jobUid} AND target.status = 'failed' AND newer.id IS NULL

UPDATE vocabulary_generation_job SET status = 'pending', available_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, started_at = NULL, finished_at = NULL, error_code = NULL, error_message = NULL, generation_outcome = NULL, warning = NULL, lease_token = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE status = 'running' AND lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND attempt_count < 3

UPDATE vocabulary_generation_job job INNER JOIN vocabulary_card card ON card.card_uid = job.card_uid SET job.status = 'failed', job.error_code = 'LEASE_EXPIRED', job.error_message = 'Generation lease expired after maximum attempts', job.generation_outcome = 'failed', job.warning = 'generation_failed', job.finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, job.lease_token = NULL, job.lease_expires_at = NULL, job.updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, card.updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, card.status = CASE WHEN card.active_revision_uid IS NULL AND card.status = 'generating' THEN 'failed' ELSE card.status END WHERE job.status = 'running' AND job.lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND job.lease_expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND job.attempt_count >= 3
